name: zinterp_context_report_errorf
description: zInterp_Context::ReportErrorf marks the current interpreter line as errored and forwards the message to the installed log hook when one exists.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c5520 validates setting lineHadError at context offset 0x10, loading logFn at context offset 0x70, returning when the hook is null, and forwarding fmt plus the varargs tail pointer.
The native smoke verifies ReportErrorf sets lineHadError, leaves errorCount unchanged, and forwards the format string and first integer vararg through the installed hook.
